entry_scope: Metadata by default, or evidence assessment after chat permission. Molecular evidence generation composes existing loaders and the documented numerical/native bridges; no automatic H4 launcher.

physical_conditions.CDF: ordinary number representation, original-g corrected kappa, general K original frames

proposal.candidate_schedule: One fixed s/r/K across all13 rounds per candidate; no adaptive extension
proposal.engineering_allowance: binary64_operation_scale_guard8_v1 retained only within its existing equivalence scope
proposal.numerical_evidence_kind: numerically_qualified_pilot; not a rigorous error proof
proposal.basis_policy: full-frame only; adjacent exact basis sharing and angle combining equally for both arms
proposal.long_round_depth: scheduled_serial_sum; no global recompile/interkernel fusion discount
proposal.readout: Compile ancilla H head and X/Y readout separately; retain intervening-kernel fence, include one ancilla measurement per shot
proposal.cost_interval_method: IID Hoeffding conditional on valid all-law support bounds; never observed min/max or SE
proposal.selection: Compare best feasible deterministic and best feasible PR per arm separately; primary RZ then fixed lexicographic (s,r,K)
proposal.seed_policy: task-bound common master with separate arm streams and corresponding candidate/m/axis/sample/occurrence IDs; no paired-variance reduction assumed; calibration and virtual-outcome domains separate

input_load.scope: Saved XDF whitelist only; no Hamiltonian generation

fit_export_load.scope: Decode existing kappa/J/U/constant once; no fit

saved_native_kernel_load.scope: Two compiled and two raw QPY for exact s1 deterministic identity reuse

ground_eigenpair.scope: Saved sector physical/CDF/XDF; eigensolves3, no DF norm repeat

model_prepare.scope: Existing CDF/XDF native adapters; 12 one-body/frame diagonalizations total

xdf_full_generator.scope: one-body+c and10 frames; not saved in Stage2

state_alias_sector_checks.scope: Arm ground-state embedding, alias and intermediate-sector diagnostics; use full256 regardless unless closure qualified

split_native_model.scope: LD2 per arm; scalar identity extracted once

gaussian_build.scope: Maximum9 CDF+11 XDF bases, cached by exact rotation and model identity

rte_configuration.scope: 2 arms x2 s x2 r x2 K; includes existing finite law normalization

exact_model_evolution.scope: 2 arms x13 times; share across candidates

kernel_reference.scope: 4 deterministic+16 PR; local exp cache per arm, corrected finite Taylor matrix

round_reference.scope: 20x13; at most2 matrix powers+2 spectral norms+observed signal per unit

feasibility_assessment.scope: Signal geometry and candidate phase budget only; no actual quantum shots

cost_kernel_sample.scope: 16 PR candidates x32 independent trajectories; each includes r<=16 existing RTE events

circuit_build.scope: 512 PR kernels+2 deterministic s4 kernels+head and X/Y readout3; no long-q materialization

compile.scope: P0 on the same517 builds; existing s1 native kernels reused only if IR identity agrees

raw_reference_check.scope: Each new build: independent CAR/event target and controlled operator; checks composite not per internal matmul

actual_adjoint_check.scope: Each new coherent kernel inverse and direct target adjoint; measured readout3 uses unitary segment before measurement

compiled_reference_check.scope: Controlled relative phase and unitarity; readout before measurement

xy_pair_check.scope: 512 PR+2 new deterministic; exact state/signal contraction with split shells, not full long-q circuits

metrics.scope: Native metric vector per new compiled segment

synthesis_qualification.scope: Full-law kernel/shell error assumption and linear repetition composition; sample max alone insufficient

cost_interval_assessment.scope: Known support bounds and simultaneous Hoeffding, otherwise point-only

final_round_assessment.scope: 20x13; actual fixed evidence through assess_round including shots if qualified

energy_assessment.scope: All13 rounds and dDF reserve per candidate

candidate_selection.scope: CDF/XDF x deterministic/PR; minimize same primary expected RZ with declared tie rule

virtual_rpe_batch.scope: Selected protocols only;1000 independent marginal-binomial trials each, not actual quantum executions

cdf_xdf_comparison.scope: Deterministic and PR separately; interval qualification and scope required

call_policy: Composite logical units; internals declared in each row; no extra per-matmul billing. Omit dependent costs for infeasible candidates. No hidden adaptive grid or scientific retry.
order: saved data reuse and required XDF generators
cached full-model reference and registered candidate feasibility
round shots and common energy gate
registered selection and independent virtual RPE
publish partial or complete evidence then mandatory STOP
outstanding_scientific_choices: Adopt exact CA representative, time/horizon, s/r/K grid and failure allocation
Adopt own-DF sector ground oracle and state-preparation-excluded cost scope
Adopt ideal finite-RTE reference-law conditional model or qualify actual law
Supply/qualify whole-law synthesis bounds and cost support bounds; otherwise no certified total/superiority
Explicit chat permission for fixed scope, SOURCE, saved inputs and fresh output
correctness_fail: First scientific correctness FAIL or SOURCE/input mismatch: stop dependents, preserve partial evidence; no repair-and-rerun under this proposed contract
candidate_infeasible: Record INFEASIBLE or UNRESOLVED; omit dependent cost, continue only other registered candidates. If no selected protocol: INFEASIBLE_REGISTERED_GRID or UNRESOLVED_QUALIFICATION; no automatic expansion
preserve: Old SOURCE/results/grant/ledger/marker/STOP unchanged; no new approval-proof system
resource_policy: No arbitrary CPU/RAM/GPU/workers/wall cap. Inspect available resources, parallelize independent candidates/calibration, coordinate BLAS, full256 unless all intermediate sector closure qualified. Preserve shared environments and other users.
forbidden_automatic_followup: Long-q global compile or unqualified proxy extrapolation
